lines.en: Come on, people. Please, let me make some room.
-Uh, sweetie, maybe you'd be more comfortable here.
-Look, I know how miserable you are.
I wish there was something I can do.
I mean, I wish I were a seahorse.
Because with seahorses, it's the male.
And then, also, um, I'd be far away in the sea.
-Oh, I have never been so uncomfortable
Could you tell it to me
while you're getting me some iced tea?
Get out, get out, get out!
